rule.name: Command Injection via eval
rule.rule_desc: The code invokes an interpreter, process, dynamic expression, or template-execution mechanism. Trace executable selection and evaluated content to their trust boundaries.
rule.vuln_desc: If an attacker controls interpreted syntax or the operation selected, code or commands may run with the application’s privileges, allowing data theft, state changes, or service disruption.
rule.developer: Replace externally influenced evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs. Use separate argument arrays for processes, allowlist permitted operations, and keep untrusted text out of executable templates or expressions.
rule.reviewer: Trace the data source for all eval arguments. Confirm no path allows attacker-controlled input. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Overly Permissive chmod
rule.rule_desc: The code accesses, creates, deletes, or shares filesystem data. Resolve path provenance, destination containment, permission modes, and any concurrent access.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker controlling a path or shared file may read or replace private files, delete data, or redirect an operation outside its intended directory if containment and access controls are ineffective.
rule.developer: Resolve paths beneath a fixed permitted root and verify containment and effective permissions. Use safe exclusive temporary-file creation, restrict sharing, and account for symlinks and concurrent changes.
rule.reviewer: Verify the permission level is justified and the affected path cannot be exploited by a lower-privilege user. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: World-Readable Sensitive File Write

rule.vuln_desc: Unauthorized changes to system authentication or configuration files may grant privileged access or establish persistence; exposure of readable secrets may also compromise account credentials.
rule.developer: Restrict who can modify sensitive system files, validate the written content, and apply least-privileged file permissions through an approved administrative workflow.
rule.reviewer: Confirm whether writes to these paths are intentional, authorized, and include validation. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: curl with TLS Verification Disabled
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a transport-security exception, insecure endpoint, or certificate-validation configuration. Resolve the effective policy and the connections it governs.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker on the network may read or alter affected traffic if sensitive data travels over cleartext or the connection accepts an untrusted server. Normal HTTPS endpoints and correctly implemented validation do not establish exposure.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS with normal certificate-chain and hostname verification. Remove permissive production callbacks and broad transport exceptions; restrict any justified exception to a documented, non-sensitive endpoint.
rule.reviewer: Verify this flag is not present in production scripts or CI pipelines. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Missing errexit or pipefail Options
rule.rule_desc: The code configures failure handling or resource consumption. Determine whether failure paths preserve security invariants and whether work is bounded.
rule.vuln_desc: Unhandled failures or unbounded work may disrupt availability or leave security-relevant state inconsistent. The presence or absence of a named handler alone does not establish a reachable security defect.
rule.developer: Bound resource use, handle failures at the correct ownership boundary, and fail safely before updating trusted state. Test exceptional paths, cancellation, timeouts, and recovery behavior.
rule.reviewer: Verify critical scripts have proper error handling enabled. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: sudo Usage Without Privilege Validation
rule.rule_desc: The code or deployment configuration requests privileges or grants access beyond an explicitly resolved minimum. Determine the effective permissions and the operation’s requirements.
rule.vuln_desc: A compromised actor may access additional data, modify protected resources, or extend compromise beyond the intended application boundary when excessive privileges remain available.
rule.developer: Run with the least privileges required, remove unnecessary grants, and scope each permission to its intended resource and operation. Verify effective inherited permissions and test denied access.
rule.reviewer: Review all sudo invocations for necessity, scope, and surrounding validation logic. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
